visual.general_description: Six-image montage of brain scans arranged in two rows of three: a top row of grayscale axial head sections and a bottom row of two axial and one coronal MRI-style sections.
visual.detailed_description: No panel letters, labels, side markers, arrows, scale bars, patient text or burned-in text are visible. Top row: three grayscale axial head sections with a bright skull ring around textured brain tissue on a black background. The first section shows a small, well-defined bright focus within the brain tissue. The second section shows a larger irregular bright area with a darker surrounding band, adjacent to dark air-like regions near the front of the head. The third section is at the level of the eyeballs and nasal region and shows a thin bright crescent along the inner skull margin on one side. Bottom row: the first two sections are axial images of the brain with bright fluid-filled ventricles, a heavily mixed bright and dark patchy region in one hemisphere including a round lesion with a dark rim, and patchy bright areas at the back of the head. The third image is a coronal section with a bright, butterfly-shaped central ventricular system and patchy bright areas along the lateral side of one hemisphere. The image does not print which side of the patient is shown, so laterality in the caption is a caption claim.

Bottom row: axial and coronal brain sections with bright ventricles and heterogeneous patchy signal

evidence.quote:
Fig. 1
Image studies.Three CT axial sections show a heterogeneous area of ​​intraparenchymal and subarachnoid bleeding, and intracerebral hematoma in the right frontal lobe. Two axial MRI sections in a FLAIR sequence show the extension of the lesion, involving the lateral aspects of the right frontal lobe, with extension to deep white matter, the anterior insular cortex, and the right occipito-temporo-parietal cortex, as well as hemorrhagic infarction in both occipital lobes. A coronal T2 MRI section shows the lesion in the lateral aspect of the right hemisphere
Fig. 1

clinical_significance.statement: The case description cites Figure 1 for a pre-surgical CT showing heterogeneous intra-parenchymal and subarachnoid bleeding, perilesional edema and a right frontal intra-cerebral hematoma; the caption separately describes CT and MRI sections of the lesion.

evidence.quote: As may be seen in Fig. 1, a CT scan before brain surgery showed a heterogeneous area of intra-parenchymal and subarachnoid bleeding and perilesional edema with a right frontal intra-cerebral hematoma.

limitations: No panel letters or side markers are printed; image laterality is not read from pixels and the right-sided findings are caption claims.
Which of the six sections correspond to the CT sections and the FLAIR and T2 sections is inferred from the caption wording and the row layout of grayscale appearance, not from printed labels.
No clinical diagnosis is made from pixels.
